content.value_statement: Complex reviews can miss risks when one reviewer checks every concern. This skill structures multi-agent review workflows across security, architecture, performance, compliance, and code quality.
actual_capabilities: Defines agent roles for security, architecture, performance, compliance, and quality review.
Explains routing logic for selecting specialized reviewers based on project context.
Outlines parallel, sequential, and hybrid review execution patterns.
Describes consolidation methods for merging findings into one prioritized report.
Provides quality validation concepts for cross-agent review confidence.
limitations: Provides guidance and pseudocode, not a complete runnable review platform.
Requires the user to supply the project context and review goals.
Does not include concrete integrations with CI systems or issue trackers.
Does not replace manual validation of security or compliance findings.

use_cases.title: Plan a broad code review
use_cases.description: Use the skill to divide a large review across security, performance, architecture, and quality perspectives.

use_cases.title: Design review agent workflows
use_cases.description: Use the routing and execution patterns to define how specialized review agents share context and results.

use_cases.title: Prepare release readiness checks
use_cases.description: Use the orchestration model to combine implementation, testing, deployment, and compliance review inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic review plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a small project review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan a multi-agent review for this project: [project summary]. Include the agent roles and review order.

prompt_templates.title: Route reviewers by risk
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for targeted review coverage.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to select review agents for this codebase: [context]. Focus on security, performance, architecture, and compliance risks.

prompt_templates.title: Synthesize competing findings
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced synthesis after multiple reviewers report results.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to merge these reviewer findings into one prioritized report: [findings]. Resolve conflicts and explain confidence levels.

prompt_templates.title: Design an orchestration process
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow design for repeatable review operations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a repeatable multi-agent review workflow for [team or product]. Include routing, context sharing, validation, and escalation.

output_examples.input: Plan a multi-agent review for a payment service before release.
output_examples.output: A review plan with security, architecture, performance, compliance, and testing reviewers, plus a recommended execution sequence.

output_examples.input: Merge conflicting security and performance recommendations from two reviewers.
output_examples.output: A consolidated finding list with priority, confidence, tradeoffs, and follow-up validation steps.

output_examples.input: Create a review workflow for a microservices migration.
output_examples.output: A hybrid orchestration plan that separates parallel service checks from sequential architecture and deployment readiness reviews.

best_practices: Define review goals and project constraints before assigning agent roles.
Keep shared context concise so each reviewer has the same source of truth.
Validate final recommendations with tests, logs, benchmarks, or human review.
anti_patterns: Do not treat pseudocode examples as a complete implementation.
Do not merge reviewer findings without checking conflicts and evidence quality.
Do not route sensitive projects to broad review agents without clear data boundaries.

faq.question: What does this skill help me do?
faq.answer: It helps structure code reviews that use multiple specialized review perspectives.

faq.question: Does this skill run review agents automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow guidance, role definitions, and pseudocode for orchestration.

faq.question: Which review areas does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers security, architecture, performance, compliance, testing, and code quality review perspectives.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it useful for small projects?
faq.answer: Yes. For small projects, use fewer agents and focus on the highest risk review areas.

faq.question: What should I verify after using it?
faq.answer: Verify important findings with tests, benchmarks, logs, documentation, or human reviewer approval.
